rubric: One answer with four plausible alternatives
Observed runtime or explicit document-backed contract
Distinct reasoning, professional formatting and appropriate prerequisites

records.finding: Replaced the strict-float draft because it repeated legacy PQ-004. Nowdoc tests literal variable text and the delimiter newline boundary without interpolation or generated variants.
Spaceship alternatives distinguish ordering signs from Boolean comparison and arithmetic distance; all three relations appear in one compact trace.
Negative explode limit removes trailing components rather than grouping the tail; the input includes enough separators to separate the alternatives.
The source literal uses digit separators, not an encoded numeric string. No runtime parsing or locale assumption is hidden.
Negative input distinguishes floor, ceil and truncation, avoiding the coincidental agreement found with positive integers.
Two omitted arguments and a reused explicit object distinguish per-call default construction from singleton or cloned-default assumptions.
The closed resource remains a variable with a closed-resource debug type while is_resource is false; no read on the closed handle is attempted.
Two differently cased constant names distinguish declaration identity from uppercase naming convention.
String XOR/AND/OR use hex output to make binary bytes and unequal-length behavior unambiguous.
The delegated return is explicitly yielded by the outer generator, while the outer final return remains separate; not another generator-start timing exercise.
Temporary Closure::call binding is observed before, during and after the call, excluding an accidental permanent rebinding explanation.
The included file is separate; local variables and globally declared named functions are contrasted, extending beyond the earlier local include assignment question.

Initial coalescing assumption was rejected by both runtimes. With __get and no __isset, direct read and coalescing retrieve visible while isset is false; the corrected key is archived against the rejected draft.
January 1 is intentionally in the prior ISO week-year; Y and o are identified separately instead of attributing the result to timezone drift.
Pure enum JSON failure is caught and prints unsupported. Its longer literal answer is the actual program output, not explanatory padding; no length-balancing text was added.
Named arguments reaching __call preserve string keys and supplied order, unlike declared parameter binding; the missing method is deliberate.
Replaced a failed stat-cache premise with row advancement by fetchColumn. The three-row fixture distinguishes column selection from row cursor movement.
The global exception handler outputs a marker but does not resume the throwing script; the process exits normally after the handler under the checked CLI behavior.
The PHP 8.4 readonly setter-scope change permits child initialization but not a second write; version and inherited storage are explicit.
Backed hook self-access reaches backing storage. The setter count and normalized reads distinguish recursion from legitimate hook dispatch.
Class attributes are not inherited, while an inherited method retains its declaring method metadata; the two reflection targets are deliberately different.
FETCH_LAZY aliases one live PDORow view while a copied scalar retains the first value; distinct from fetchColumn row advancement and deferred input binding.
A nonfinal typed constant narrows int|float to int covariantly; finality and ordinary value replacement are not conflated.
A widened set-hook input permits string under strict typing while the getter retains int. This concerns input/read contracts, not the assignment-expression value tested earlier.
The two-file Override typo fails when require loads the child, after the main prefix. Runtime explicitly expects the fatal declaration diagnostic; it is not labeled valid deployable source.
A middle negative value makes continue, break, return and throw produce distinguishable outcomes; the skip policy is explicit.
Two trusted callable names prevent a hard-coded strlen substitute from satisfying the fixture; no user-controlled function dispatch is executed.
The array return declaration distinguishes default object decoding from associative decoding even when re-encoded JSON could look the same.
The physical blank line is meaningful; IGNORE_NEW_LINES changes representation while SKIP_EMPTY_LINES changes membership.
The complete PHP/HTML template runs with short_open_tag explicitly disabled. Short echo remains available, and a bare evaluated variable does not emit text.
Both omission and explicit null must remain accepted without the PHP 8.4 deprecation. mixed and a required nullable parameter violate different parts of the contract.
A fixed SERVER fixture distinguishes encoded request path from query data and front-controller script path; no real server environment is presumed.
The inventory explicitly treats dangling symlinks as occupied names. This is read-only documentation review, not an atomic creation or traversal-safety claim.
POSIX mode and umask are explicit; fixture cleanup restores owner access after observing every candidate's mode. No ACL or Windows claim is made.
The required configured instance has live: state; a new valid instance is still wrong, and both class-style calls are verified failures.
Bound values are raw data, so quote, addslashes and doubled apostrophes corrupt stored content. The in-memory SQLite fixture observes each candidate.
The reset token position determines which fields are cleared. Current date is explicitly outside the epoch date, and the key produces a deterministic timestamp.
PHP output and a separate JavaScript JSON.parse probe verify exact large-ID preservation. The object shape requirement rejects replacing the whole payload with a scalar string.
Unregistering requires the registered closure instance, not equivalent source or deletion of a local reference; callbacks record names without loading files.
Both dynamic-call warning paths are expected diagnostics. A reference to a copy is valid PHP but fails the required mutation of the original variable.
PSR-18 returns a well-formed 404 normally; request and network exceptions have explicit contrary premises. Documentation review is not represented as an HTTP integration test.
An interface constructor requirement remains binding despite ordinary parent constructor flexibility. All incompatible signatures and narrowed visibility are checked on both runtimes.

The Linux helper's atomic resolution contract is explicit, including excluded hard-link/mount attacks and no promise about later renames. Rechecking or exclusive leaf creation cannot remove ancestor races.
The Fiber never suspends, so start returns null and getReturn is the result channel. Before-start and after-termination misuse have verified distinct errors.
The SQLite cursor has remaining rows; one more fetch still leaves it active. closeCursor releases the schema lock, unlike count or fetch-mode inspection.
Postfix return supplies the old value despite a completed local increment; the prefix contrast changes both independent calls without mutating caller state.
The loop reassigns a by-value element variable. Explicit keyed writeback preserves associative identities and changes both stored names.
Replaced the near-repeat of abstract-class behavior with final versus immutable. Construction, mutation and cloning all succeed; the restriction is class extension.
Rejected the interface-membership draft as an exact repeat of 0208. The replacement tests min's empty-array ValueError and explicit nullable recovery.
Integer keys are record identities, not positions. Reversal order and preservation are separate requirements; sorting or reindexing cannot satisfy both.
Both old Host and new URI host are nonempty, making preserveHost's effect determinate. The returned immutable request is assigned, so no discarded-result defect is mixed in.
Shared writable body identity is an explicit premise. Rewinding cannot undo overwritten bytes, and changing header APIs does not establish independent stream ownership.
Authentication succeeds and POST is understood, excluding 401 and 501. Allow is distinguished from CORS metadata for a resource-specific 405.
The precise Lax top-level safe-navigation condition is stated. The flaw is a mutating GET receiving the session cookie, not an unsupported claim that Lax never helps with CSRF.
A nonbrowser caller can supply Origin, so CORS response sharing cannot establish user identity. Authentication and authorization are separate required checks.
setcookie success concerns response construction, not remote acknowledgement or current COOKIE mutation; browser rejection is an explicit possibility.
The CLI session fixture uses only its owned directory, disables cookie/header behavior and destroys the session after reopening. The post-close local assignment is not persisted.
Winter and summer instants use explicit Zurich rules. Arithmetic offset shifting changes the instant and cannot replace named-zone representation.
POSIX is explicit; unlink removes the name while an earlier descriptor retains readable bytes. No claim is made about Windows sharing semantics.
Replaced the blank-CSV draft because it repeated 0234. The final callback contract permits short reads before EOF; a deterministic three-chunk witness validates accumulation without external I/O.
never is contrasted with void under a string-returning interface. The valid throwing implementation and incompatible void declaration are both observed.
Trait constant composition requires compatible values, unlike method precedence. Equal declarations run and a changed class value triggers the expected composition failure.
Adding an exact string member changes representation of already accepted numeric strings in weak mode. Both original and widened signatures are executed.
Parent and child private id slots remain distinct. Separate declaration scans demonstrate why child filtering or accessibility changes cannot produce a complete inventory.
A deterministic Fiber schedule demonstrates shared error-handler state. The answer was shortened to its behavioral conclusion rather than carrying an extra repair hint.
The fixture includes zero, a finite negative, both infinities and NaN, separating numeric admission, sign and finiteness.
Exactly representable half-unit input avoids floating error distractions. Integer modulo, quotient and rounded modulo are realistic but different operations.
A later digit run and an initially nondigit string distinguish leading-span scanning from total digit count and complementary span length.
The first histogram fixture accidentally let array_flip match the answer. Reordering to red,red,blue separates last indexes from frequencies; all four candidates were rerun.
A quoted embedded comma defeats split-count and quote-removal shortcuts. This tests field boundaries within one record, not the earlier embedded-newline record reader.
Repeated surrounding text makes global replacement wrong. Explicit offset and removed-byte length separate replacement, insertion and replacement-to-end.
The existing queue item and flat shape are required. Nested append, replacement and assigning array_push's count each violate a different observable property.
The source encoding is known Windows-1252, so byte 0x80 must become euro rather than a replacement or Latin-1 control. All candidate conversions are observed.
Full folding's multi-character sharp-s mapping distinguishes it from mb_strtolower, simple folding and normalization. This goes beyond the earlier ASCII-only strtolower limitation.
The relative Retry-After form and upward rounding are explicit; milliseconds, fractional grammar and truncation are distinct realistic errors.
The listing includes a hidden file and a real directory, so broad dot filters and is_file cannot accidentally satisfy the exact dot-entry exclusion contract.
One incremental hash state receives original bytes in order. Per-chunk hashes, reset state and hexadecimal text all change the authenticated message input.
The library checkout is the root while the consumer sees it as a dependency. autoload-dev's root-only scope is not repaired by optimization or consumer dev mode.
The allocator's atomic durable range contract and no-rollback premise are explicit. Gaps are permitted; every wrong design has a specific concurrency or crash reuse window.
The composite cursor tests timestamp ties and an earlier row with a larger ID, extending beyond the earlier single increasing-ID pagination question. No frozen-snapshot claim is made.
The Gregorian century rule is stated, making the test about selecting a distinguishing fixture rather than recalling calendar trivia. Only 1900 exposes the incomplete rule.
Scheme and host checks are already complete. Only implicit-versus-explicit HTTPS default port separates raw representation from effective origin identity.
The assertion follows strcmp's sign contract rather than a guaranteed magnitude. The runtime witness shows a conforming negative result that is not minus one.
The requirement deliberately demands exact exception class and failure on normal return. The answer was shortened; PHPUnit subclass-compatible expectations are explicitly insufficient.
All inputs have valid scheme syntax; only mixed-case credential bytes expose whole-header lowercasing. The repair preserves token bytes without claiming full malformed-header validation.
Four-decimal equality is explicit. A fourth-place difference exposes scale two, while equivalent trailing-zero and already-visible differences remain controls.
Different parent and child IDs reveal duplicate associative SQL labels. Equal IDs are intentional nondiscriminating controls, and the alias repair is executed for all fixtures.
The bounded helper handles one valid tag or no header for GET only. Weak-versus-strong equivalent opaque tags expose the wrong equality; wildcard/list parsing is explicitly out of scope.
The test primes and reuses one URL with different negotiation input. Cold-cache, same-language and different-URL alternatives cannot reveal the missing Vary dimension.
Subprocess status is distinct from stdout. The string exit prints one with status zero; the integer contrast produces status one, without running exit in the app.
The protocol explicitly requires canonical padded Base64 and allows empty bytes. Nonzero pad bits distinguish strict decodability from exact re-encoding equality.
Total attempts include the first attempt, preventing retry-count ambiguity. The nested worst-case products are 27, 9 and 3; backoff alone changes timing only.
Optional adapters own their enforced extension requirements. Core-wide requirements violate optionality, while suggest and require-dev fail the installation guarantee.
Two currencies share the same minor-unit scale, so missing currency identity cannot be hidden by scale differences. Bounded integers exclude overflow and exchange-rate questions.
Consistency is scoped to one checkout while freshness is required for the next. Per-call, process-lifetime and permanent-user caching each violate a stated boundary.
Class discovery must remain free of network effects, including tooling and disabled integrations. Moving the same top-level call does not change activation timing.
Publishers use rename and never mutate published files in place. That premise makes fstat plus reads on one descriptor a valid version-consistency guarantee.
Canonical lowercase ASCII identity and PostgreSQL case-sensitive raw storage are explicit. A unique canonical key addresses both equivalence and concurrent insertion races.
Durable queue acknowledgement is defined, and no paired database mutation is involved. FPM response finishing, shutdown callbacks and Fibers retain process-local ownership.
The provider signs raw bytes with no canonicalization contract. Bounded capture and verification precede parsing/dispatch; replay is explicitly handled elsewhere.
